title: A small practice, on purpose.
lede: Four people, two treatment rooms and appointments long enough to talk properly. That is the whole idea.
imageAlt: A calm, sunlit treatment room with a single dental chair.
story: Ana spent nine years in a downtown group practice where every check-up was booked into fifteen minutes. She liked the people. She did not like watching patients leave confused about what had just happened in their own mouths.
In 2016 she took over a tired single-chair surgery on SE Tacoma Street, knocked through to the empty shop next door, and opened Linden with a simple rule: book less, explain more.
Ten years on, most new patients find us through a neighbour. A lot of them have not seen a dentist in years. We think that says more about how dentistry is usually delivered than about them.
principlesTitle: What you can hold us to

principles.title: Longer appointments
principles.body: An hour for a check-up, double time for nervous patients. We see fewer people a day so nobody is rushed.

principles.title: Prices before treatment
principles.body: You get the full cost in writing before you agree to anything, including what insurance should cover.

principles.title: A stop signal you control
principles.body: Raise your left hand and we stop. Every time, no questions, no sighing.

principles.title: Explain, never lecture
principles.body: We show you what we see on screen and tell you what can wait. Flossing guilt is not part of the service.

ctaText: New patients are welcome most weeks. Book online, or call June and ask her anything first.
